name: PAM_SUCCESS
description: Successful function return

name: PAM_PERM_DENIED
description: Permission denied

name: PAM_AUTH_ERR
description: Authentication failure (wrong password)

name: PAM_CRED_INSUFFICIENT
description: Caller does not have credentials to authenticate the user

name: PAM_AUTHINFO_UNAVAIL
description: Authentication service could not retrieve authentication information (e.g. LDAP/network down)

name: PAM_USER_UNKNOWN
description: User not known to the underlying authentication module

name: PAM_MAXTRIES
description: Retry limit reached (module-specific, e.g. faillock)

name: PAM_NEW_AUTHTOK_REQD
description: New authentication token (password) required — the old one has expired

name: PAM_ACCT_EXPIRED
description: User account has expired

name: PAM_SESSION_ERR
description: Cannot make/remove an entry for the specified session

name: PAM_CRED_UNAVAIL
description: Underlying authentication service cannot retrieve user credentials

name: PAM_CRED_EXPIRED
description: User credentials have expired

name: PAM_CRED_ERR
description: Failure setting user credentials

name: PAM_AUTHTOK_ERR
description: Authentication token manipulation error

name: PAM_AUTHTOK_RECOVERY_ERR
description: Old authentication token could not be recovered

name: PAM_AUTHTOK_LOCK_BUSY
description: Authentication token lock busy

name: PAM_AUTHTOK_DISABLE_AGING
description: Authentication token aging disabled

name: PAM_TRY_AGAIN
description: Preliminary check by password service failed

name: PAM_IGNORE
description: Ignore underlying account module regardless of whether it succeeded or failed

name: PAM_ABORT
description: Critical error, module fails, application should abort use of this service

name: PAM_AUTHTOK_EXPIRED
description: User's authentication token has expired

name: PAM_INCOMPLETE
description: Module needs the application to call it again to complete authentication
